name: The Judgement Day
overview: Scripture reveals that Judgment Day is a definitive event appointed by God, when Christ, whom He raised from the dead, will judge the world in righteousness. It is a solemn moment following death, where each person will face the righteous judgment of God, resulting either in eternal separation from Him or vindication. The Bible warns that unrepentant hearts store up wrath for this day, highlighting the urgent call to repentance. The vision of a great white throne emphasizes the majesty and finality of this divine judgment.
